evidence.quote: ADB SAFEGATE will deliver a complete airfield ground lighting (AGL) solution, including approach, runway and taxiway integrated with its new LINC 360 Individual Light Control and Monitoring System (ILCMS).
Marking the largest airfield lighting contract in ADB SAFEGATE Australia’s history, the company is set to deliver its latest Airfield 4.0 technology to Western Sydney International (WSI) Airport.

ADB SAFEGATE will replace the original Data Fusion System with a state-of-the-art Multi-sensor Data Fusion System that is fully compliant with the latest EUROCAE ED-87 standards and is core to ADB SAFEGATE’s OneControl Surveillance Service.
ALIS is also in use at McCarran International Airport in Las Vegas, the Birmingham Airport in the UK and Qatar’s Hamad International Airport
